note: Scripture and prayer text is taken verbatim from daily_briefs.json, content this app already ships. Quotes are public-domain and attributed. Reframes, urge lines, affirmations, stories and facts are original to Bastion.

items.text: I have made a covenant with my eyes; why then should I look at a young woman?
Father, You know exactly what I am carrying and You have not turned away. Give me one honest day. Make me the kind of man who keeps his word to You.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Lord, be present help, not distant judge. When the pull comes, remind me You are nearer than the craving is loud.

No temptation has overtaken you that is not common to man. God is faithful, and he will not let you be tempted beyond your ability, but with the temptation he will also provide the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
Father, thank You that this is not beyond me and I am not beyond You. Show me the door tonight, and give me the courage to walk through it.
And the angel of the LORD came again a second time and touched him and said, Arise and eat, for the journey is too great for you.
Lord, You know I am dust and You are not disappointed by it. Feed me, steady me, and let my rest tonight be part of my obedience.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.
God, You have never been shocked by me. Give me the nerve to be known by someone who will walk with me, and let me stay in the light.
The steadfast love of the LORD never ceases; his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
Father, thank You that Your mercy is not rationed. I am not going to hide or wallow. Meet me here and walk me forward today.
He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul.
Shepherd, I have been braced for a long time. Make me lie down. Restore what this has cost me and teach me to rest without guilt.
Put on the new self, created after the likeness of God in true righteousness and holiness.
Lord, You do not just take things away, You give. Show me what to put in the empty hour, and make the new man in me feel like the real one.
Keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life.
Father, give me the humility to build fences rather than trust my own strength. Guard my heart where I cannot guard it myself.
And rising very early in the morning, while it was still dark, he departed and went out to a desolate place, and there he prayed.
Lord, let my first thought tomorrow be toward You rather than a screen. Set the tone of the day before anything else can.
For while bodily training is of some value, godliness is of value in every way, as it holds promise for the present life and also for the life to come.
Lord, thank You for a body, not just a soul. Teach me to steward it, and let the strength I build serve something beyond myself.
In peace I will both lie down and sleep; for you alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
Lord, You keep watch when I sleep. Let me lie down in peace tonight rather than in tension, and guard my mind through the dark hours.
Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men.
Lord, You worked and called it good. Let my work today be offered to You, and let it draw out the best of me rather than the least.
Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewal of your mind, that by testing you may discern what is the will of God, what is good and acceptable and perfect.
Father, renew my mind where I cannot reach it. Change what I want, not just what I do, and give me patience with the pace of it.
Search me, O God, and know my heart! Try me and know my thoughts! And see if there be any grievous way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting!
Search me, God, and be gentle with what You find. Show me what I have been running from, and lead me somewhere better than escape.
Then the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a helper fit for him.
Father, You said it is not good for me to be alone and You meant it. Give me courage to reach for real people instead of a substitute.
Therefore, confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed.
Lord, You put us in a body, not in solitary confinement. Give me one or two honest men, and make me that kind of man for someone else.
So teach us to number our days that we may get a heart of wisdom.
Lord, teach me to number my days. Slow me down enough to be present with You in the quiet instead of always reaching for noise.
Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
Jesus, You called the exhausted, not the impressive. I bring the pressure I have been carrying to You instead of to my old escape.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Lord, my wants are not too big, they are too small. Reshape my desires until the real thing looks better than the substitute.
There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
Father, thank You that there is no condemnation left for me. Let me feel honest sorrow without drowning, and let Your kindness lead me forward.
Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.
Lord, You call me new before I feel new. Help me live out of what You have already said about me rather than what I have done.
Let what you say be simply Yes or No; anything more than this comes from evil.
Lord, make my yes mean yes. Rebuild my integrity in the small hidden places, and let my word be worth something because Yours is.
For you were called to freedom, brothers. Only do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.
Lord, You set me free for something, not just from something. Show me one person to serve today and let me do it without needing credit.
Treat older women as mothers, younger women as sisters, in all purity.
Father, give me clean eyes. Teach me to see women as Your daughters, and let honour become my reflex rather than appetite.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.
Lord, You made me for something and prepared it in advance. Give me clear eyes for the work in front of me and the energy to walk in it.
The prudent sees danger and hides himself, but the simple go on and suffer for it.
Lord, give me the foresight to prepare rather than presume. When the hard day comes, let me find the plan already made and Your help already there.
In all things I have shown you that by working hard in this way we must help the weak and remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he himself said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
Lord, let what has cost me something become useful to someone else. Give me the humility to speak plainly and the wisdom to know when.
Therefore, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us also lay aside every weight, and sin which clings so closely, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us.
Lord, thank You that I am not running this alone or unseen. Help me lay aside what slows me and give me endurance rather than speed.
And let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give up.
Father, thank You for these thirty days, the good ones and the failures. Keep me from growing weary, and keep me walking with You into the next stretch.
You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.
The best revenge is not to be like your enemy.
Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
Confine yourself to the present.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
Drunkenness is nothing but a condition of insanity purposely assumed.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
It is impossible for a man to learn what he thinks he already knows.
He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Mastering others is strength. Mastering yourself is true power.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
He who is contented is rich.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
Whoever is patient has great understanding, but one who is quick-tempered displays folly.
Better a patient person than a warrior, one with self-control than one who takes a city.
Nothing is so strong as gentleness, nothing so gentle as real strength.
Have patience with all things, but chiefly have patience with yourself.
Character is like a tree and reputation like a shadow. The shadow is what we think of it; the tree is the real thing.
Whatever you are, be a good one.
The best way out is always through.
Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
Nothing worth having comes without some kind of fight.
If there is no struggle, there is no progress.
It is easier to build strong children than to repair broken men.
The chains of habit are too weak to be felt until they are too strong to be broken.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
The bamboo that bends is stronger than the oak that resists.
A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
Little strokes fell great oaks.
Energy and persistence conquer all things.
Either you run the day or the day runs you.
Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear — not absence of fear.
Habit is either the best of servants or the worst of masters.
The greatest remedy for anger is delay.
The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
Never let the future disturb you. You will meet it, if you have to, with the same weapons of reason which today arm you against the present.
The object of life is not to be on the side of the majority, but to escape finding oneself in the ranks of the insane.
Look well into thyself; there is a source of strength which will always spring up if thou wilt always look.
How much more grievous are the consequences of anger than the causes of it.
Do every act of your life as if it were your last.
Nowhere can man find a quieter or more untroubled retreat than in his own soul.
Receive without pride, let go without attachment.
It is not the man who has too little, but the man who craves more, that is poor.
Every night before going to sleep, we must ask ourselves: what weakness did I overcome today?
He who is brave is free.
Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labour does the body.
Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
Associate with those who will make a better man of you.
As long as you live, keep learning how to live.
It is a rough road that leads to the heights of greatness.
A man is as unhappy as he has convinced himself he is.
While we are postponing, life speeds by.
Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views which they take of things.
Seek not that the things which happen should happen as you wish; but wish the things which happen to be as they are.
It is not he who reviles or strikes you who insults you, but your opinion that these things are insulting.
If you wish to be a writer, write. If you wish to be anything, do the thing.
Do not explain your philosophy. Embody it.
Practice yourself in little things, and thence proceed to greater.
When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
To the mind that is still, the whole universe surrenders.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom.
It does not matter how slowly you go so long as you do not stop.
When anger rises, think of the consequences.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
To see what is right and not do it is want of courage.
Better than a thousand hollow words is one word that brings peace.
Though he should conquer a thousand men a thousand times in battle, he who conquers himself is the greatest of conquerors.
All that we are is the result of what we have thought.
Opportunities multiply as they are seized.
Excellence is never an accident.
It is the mark of an educated mind to be able to entertain a thought without accepting it.
Pleasure in the job puts perfection in the work.
The greatest wealth is to live content with little.
What we achieve inwardly will change outer reality.
Character is simply habit long continued.
The life given us by nature is short; but the memory of a well-spent life is eternal.
Not to be angry is a kind of victory.
Every man is the maker of his own fortune.
Habits change into character.
Rule your mind or it will rule you.
He who has begun has half done. Dare to be wise; begin!
They can because they think they can.
Our hearts are restless until they rest in You.
Give me chastity and continence, but not yet.
Habit, if not resisted, soon becomes necessity.
First keep peace with yourself, then you can also bring peace to others.
Be not angry that you cannot make others as you wish them to be, since you cannot make yourself as you wish to be.
The heart has its reasons which reason knows nothing of.
All of humanity's problems stem from man's inability to sit quietly in a room alone.
You have not lived today until you have done something for someone who can never repay you.
By perseverance the snail reached the ark.
Anxiety does not empty tomorrow of its sorrows, but only empties today of its strength.
A little faith will bring your soul to heaven; a great faith will bring heaven to your soul.
Purity of heart is to will one thing.
items.source: Purity of Heart Is to Will One Thing
items.sourceRef: Purity of Heart Is to Will One Thing

items.text: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
Great works are performed not by strength but by perseverance.
Lost time is never found again.
It is easier to prevent bad habits than to break them.
Well done is better than well said.
The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
That which we persist in doing becomes easier — not that the nature of the task has changed, but our ability to do has increased.
Finish each day and be done with it. You have done what you could.
Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
As a single footstep will not make a path on the earth, so a single thought will not make a pathway in the mind.
It is not enough to be busy. The question is: what are we busy about?
I would unite with anybody to do right and with nobody to do wrong.
I am a slow walker, but I never walk back.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
Nothing so needs reforming as other people's habits.
Success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome.
Character, not circumstances, makes the man.
The greatest weapon against stress is our ability to choose one thought over another.
Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
Sow an action and you reap a habit; sow a habit and you reap a character; sow a character and you reap a destiny.
Our greatest glory consists not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
Permanence, perseverance and persistence in spite of all obstacles — this alone distinguishes the strong soul.
Our main business is not to see what lies dimly at a distance, but to do what lies clearly at hand.
The highest reward for a person's toil is not what they get for it, but what they become by it.
Quality is never an accident. It is always the result of intelligent effort.
It is never too late to be what you might have been.
Have a heart that never hardens, a temper that never tires, a touch that never hurts.
Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one thinks of changing himself.
The two most powerful warriors are patience and time.
Above all, don't lie to yourself.
The mystery of human existence lies not in just staying alive, but in finding something to live for.
The snake which cannot cast its skin has to die.
Whoever fights monsters should see to it that in the process he does not become a monster.
Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
Treat people as if they were what they ought to be, and you help them to become what they are capable of being.
Compassion is the basis of morality.
Be not afraid of growing slowly; be afraid only of standing still.
A single bracelet does not jingle.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
However long the night, the dawn will break.
The obstacle is the path.
Before enlightenment, chop wood, carry water. After enlightenment, chop wood, carry water.
Fortune favours the bold.
Little by little, a little becomes a lot.
He who has health has hope, and he who has hope has everything.
A wise man makes his own decisions; an ignorant man follows public opinion.
Dig the well before you are thirsty.
Vision without action is a daydream. Action without vision is a nightmare.
An urge is a wave, not an order. It rises, it peaks, it falls — and it falls whether or not you obey it.
You are not fighting a craving. You are outlasting one.
The feeling is real. The story it is telling you about what you need is not.
Nothing about this moment is an emergency. It only has the shape of one.
You have felt exactly this before and it passed. That is evidence, not hope.
Wanting it and choosing it are two different acts. Only one of them is yours to make.
It is not asking for pleasure. It is asking for relief. Name what actually needs relieving.
The urge always promises this once. It has never once meant it.
Ten minutes from now you will be a man who waited ten minutes. Start there.
Your body is not betraying you. It is doing what it was trained to do. Training can change.
The version of you that wants this is tired, not evil. Put him to bed.
Boredom is not a reason. It is an empty room. Walk into a different one.
Loneliness is asking for a person. A screen is not a person.
If you would not do it with the door open, the problem is not the door.
A slip is a data point, not a verdict.
You did not lose everything. You lost a day. Those are very different sizes.
The streak broke. The man who built it did not.
Shame will offer to punish you and call it accountability. Decline.
What you do in the next hour matters more than what you did in the last one.
Getting back up today is worth more than never having fallen.
Not tonight. Not this.
Stand up. Leave the room. That is the whole plan.
Breathe out longer than you breathe in. Four times.
This peaks in about ten minutes. You can do ten minutes.
Put the phone in another room. Right now, before you finish reading this.
Cold water on your face. Go.
Name three things you can hear. Then three you can see.
You are not in danger. You are in discomfort. They feel the same and they are not.
Text your partner one word. Any word.
Twenty press-ups. Not for fitness. To change the channel.
Say it out loud: this will pass. Out loud.
Go outside. Even for ninety seconds. Even in your slippers.
Drink a full glass of water before you decide anything.
You have already done the hard part — you opened this instead.
Do not negotiate. Negotiation is how it wins.
Set a timer for ten minutes and simply do not act until it rings.
Lie down on the floor for two minutes. It is a strange enough thing to break the loop.
Turn the light on. All of it.
Write down what actually happened in the last hour. Just facts.
Put your shoes on. You do not have to go anywhere yet.
I am not the man I was, and I am not finished.
I keep my word to myself.
My attention is mine to give.
I do not owe an urge anything.
I can feel something and not obey it.
I am building someone worth being.
Discipline is how I show myself respect.
I am allowed to begin again this morning.
What I do repeatedly is who I become.
I choose the harder right over the easier wrong.
I do not need to be perfect to be serious.
My body is not a vending machine for relief.

A swimmer caught in a rip current is told the same thing every time: do not swim against it. Swim across it, and wait. The current is enormous and it is also narrow. Men drown fighting the water in a straight line when three strokes sideways would have freed them. An urge is a rip current. You are not going to out-muscle it head on. Move sideways — a different room, a different task, a phone call — and let it carry itself out.
items.title: The Wave

items.text: An old man tells his grandson there are two wolves fighting inside him. One is anger, envy, self-pity, and appetite. The other is peace, patience, honesty, and kindness. The boy asks which one wins. The old man says: the one you feed. It is an old story and men repeat it because it is the only mechanism that has ever mattered. You are not choosing who you are in one heroic moment. You are choosing what you feed, tonight, and again tomorrow night.
items.title: The Two Wolves

items.text: Two woodcutters worked the same forest. One swung all day without stopping. The other stopped every hour and sat down. By evening the one who rested had cut twice as much. Asked how, he said: I was sharpening my axe. Men who never rest do not become more disciplined, they become blunt. Sleep is not the opposite of discipline. It is the maintenance discipline runs on.
items.title: The Woodcutter

items.text: A man who wanted to stop drinking did not rely on willpower at the moment of thirst. He gave the key of the cabinet to his neighbour. He was not weak for doing it; he was accurate. He knew which version of himself would be making the decision at nine at night, and he made sure that version had nothing to decide. This is what guards are. Not distrust of yourself — an honest appointment with who you are when it is late.
items.title: The Locked Cabinet

items.text: A wall around an old city fell in a single season and took fifty-two days to rebuild. Not fifty-two years. The men who rebuilt it worked with a tool in one hand and a weapon in the other, because rebuilding and defending had to happen at the same time. If you have fallen, you do not get a quiet period first in which to recover before life resumes. You rebuild while carrying on. It is done in far less time than shame tells you.
items.title: The Rebuilt Wall

items.text: Nobody admires the first week. It is the two-hundredth day that changes a man, and nothing about the two-hundredth day feels dramatic. It feels like an ordinary Tuesday on which you did not do the thing. That is the whole secret and it is why so few people find it: the transformation is made entirely of unremarkable evenings.
items.title: The Long Obedience

items.text: A soldier's medal came back from a war dented. He was offered a new one and refused it. The dent, he said, is the part that proves it was carried. A record without a slip in it says only that you were never tested. Your rank is not lowered by the day you fell. It is made of the days you got up.
items.title: The Dented Medal

items.text: For years he handled it alone, and alone he lost, quietly, on a schedule. The thing that finally moved was not a new blocker or a better plan. It was one sentence said to one friend: this is what I am dealing with. Nothing about the urge changed. What changed is that it stopped being a secret, and secrecy was most of its strength.
items.title: The Man Who Told Someone

items.text: Most urges peak and subside within about twenty minutes. Riding one out is not endless — it has a shape, and the shape ends.
Deliberately slowing your out-breath so it is longer than your in-breath activates the body's own calming response. It is one of the few switches you can reach directly.
Changing your physical location interrupts a craving more reliably than trying to argue with it. The context is doing more of the work than the thought is.
Sleep loss measurably reduces impulse control. A bad night is not a character failing, it is a handicap you can plan around.
Habits are driven by cues far more than by decisions. Removing the cue is easier and more effective than resisting it every time.
Naming an emotion in words reduces its intensity. Saying what you actually feel is not soft — it is a lever.
People who tell one other person about a goal relapse less often than people who keep it entirely private. Secrecy is a risk factor in its own right.
Self-compassion after a lapse predicts getting back on track better than self-criticism does. Being hard on yourself is not the more serious option — it is the less effective one.
